name: Seikan Shimai
source:
Due to messing with his grandfather's machine, the protagonist and his 2 cousins have switched body. They try to switch back right away but the machine breaks. And thus, they are stuck inside each other's bodies for a while.

[Translated from [url=http://www.noirsoft.co.jp/seikanshimai/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
